notes: The 2021 full course retains the northern first hairpin, long southern middle return, small northern hairpin, inner southern hairpin, middle northern hairpin, complete western back straight, southern switchbacks, southeastern loop and outer return to the main straight. The pit lane and outer-course shortcut are excluded. Course branch order is checked against the independently authored 2021 course plan and the simulator developer course identity. All geometry vertices are independently placed on the public AGEA 2024 orthophoto cached raster. Public tile bytes, hashes, unmodified Web Mercator grid and license evidence are retained. The source has native 20 cm pixels; the selected level-18 cache has approximately 42 cm ground pixel spacing at this latitude. Pixel size is not asserted as positional accuracy. Fine lane alignment and historical-year correspondence remain draft. No supplied course image, position, timing location or nominal distance defines a vertex. The independently measured draft is 3,728.4 m, 23.6 m shorter than the supplied 3,752 m scalar; the discrepancy remains unresolved and the geometry is not scaled. Independently digitized aerial centerline: 3728.4 m. Direction, historical configuration and fine corner alignment remain draft; no course coordinates come from the comparison catalogue.

sources.notes: Road height is sampled from the existing approximately 57 m terrain raster and compressed to a 0.5 m interpolation tolerance relative to those samples; this is not road-surface survey accuracy. Station distances use the mapped trace, not an official length measurement. The saved start gate sets the simulation origin. Curbs and bend labels are geometry-based illustrations, not extracted from imagery or verified real curb locations; widths, heights and colours are assumed. Banking is unknown and assumed zero. Source border coordinates retain their separate feature-level licence; invalid cross-sections are interpolated. Imagery is an external display resource subject to provider terms; no image bytes are included.
